name: Default
shortDescription: Synchronizes AdGuard Home settings, filters, rewrites and clients from an origin instance to replicas on a schedule, with a status dashboard.

alerts.message: Set ORIGIN_URL, ORIGIN_USERNAME, ORIGIN_PASSWORD and the REPLICA1_* variables to your existing AdGuard Home instances before syncing; the placeholders only let the dashboard start. Both instances must already be set up through the AdGuard Home wizard and reachable from this server. Add more replicas with REPLICA2_URL, REPLICA2_USERNAME, REPLICA2_PASSWORD and so on.
The dashboard uses HTTP basic auth: the user is API_USERNAME (admin) and the password is the generated API_PASSWORD.
